content: {"summary":"静态阅读完整函数后，表头校验、CSV解析、行有效性、计数分类、已知分钟累加、空有效集返回和纯函数边界均符合固定任务；未发现需要修改的静态问题。","overall":"pass","criteria":[{"criterion_id":"C01","verdict":"pass","issue_type":null,"evidence_span":"if reader.fieldnames is None or not required.issubset(reader.fieldnames):","reason":"函数在读取行前检查表头是否存在且包含record_id与duration_minutes，缺失时抛出ValueError，满足表头约束。","suggested_self_test":null,"next_action":null},{"criterion_id":"C02","verdict":"pass","issue_type":null,"evidence_span":"reader = csv.DictReader(io.StringIO(csv_text))","reason":"使用csv.DictReader解析CSV，能正确处理引号；逐行校验record_id可解析且>0、分钟空白为未知、非空可解析且0至1440，非法行计入invalid_count。","suggested_self_test":null,"next_action":null},{"criterion_id":"C03","verdict":"pass","issue_type":null,"evidence_span":"duration = None if raw == \"\" else int(raw)","reason":"空白分钟保持为None并计入missing_duration_count，已知0分钟计入known_duration_count且不当作缺失，未知与0正确区分。","suggested_self_test":null,"next_action":null},{"criterion_id":"C04","verdict":"pass","issue_type":null,"evidence_span":"out[\"known_minutes\"] += duration","reason":"仅对有效且分钟已知的行累加duration，已知0分钟加0不影响和，未知分钟不参与累加，累加逻辑正确。","suggested_self_test":null,"next_action":null},{"criterion_id":"C05","verdict":"pass","issue_type":null,"evidence_span":"out = {\"record_count\": 0, \"known_duration_count\": 0, \"known_minutes\": 0,","reason":"五个计数字段初始化为整数0，无有效行时直接返回完整五字段，满足空有效集契约。","suggested_self_test":null,"next_action":null},{"criterion_id":"C06","verdict":"pass","issue_type":null,"evidence_span":"import csv\nimport io","reason":"函数仅使用csv和io进行内存解析，不读写文件、不联网、不执行任意代码，符合纯函数与静态边界要求。","suggested_self_test":null,"next_action":null}]}
